description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class 'LocationAPI' within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It provides CRUD operations for location entities, including retrieving, listing, creating, updating, and deleting locations. The class uses various services and models to handle location data and is annotated for OpenAPI documentation.

classes.name: LocationAPI
classes.description: Defines REST API endpoints for managing location entities, including CRUD operations, with detailed validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getLocationService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the LocationService instance used for location operations.

methods.name: setLocationService
methods.description: Sets the LocationService instance for dependency injection.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single location by ID.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves and returns a specific location by ID, with error handling if not found.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing all locations with optional filters and sorting.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of locations based on search filters, pagination, and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a new location.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the common fields in location creation/update requests.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new location entity with provided data and returns it.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for deleting multiple locations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes locations specified by IDs in the request body.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an existing location.

methods.name: setLocationData
methods.description: Populates a Location entity with data from the request parameters.
